新闻报道 1 捷蓝航空一架从西棕榈滩至纽约市周日早上被迫返航降落飞机撞到鸟之后。
News Report 1 A JetBlue Airlines flight from West Palm Beach to New York City was forced to turn around and land Sunday morning after the plane struck a bird.
从 棕榈滩国际机场 飞往拉瓜地亚机场起飞几分钟后就返航罢工之后。
The flight from Palm Beach International Airport to LaGuardia Airport turned around just minutes after takeoff following the strike.
飞机上没有人员伤亡报告，航班于七点再次起飞，第一次尝试后半小时。
No injuries were reported on the plane and the flight took off once again seven and a half hours after the first attempt.
就像一瞬间的恐慌导致这种紧张的反应飞机上的乘客布莱恩·希利说道。
It was like a split second of panic that resulted in this nervous reaction on the plane, said passenger Brian Healy.
一片寂静，然后飞机停下来时我才松了一口气。
There was total quiet and then there was relief when the plane came to a stop.
JetBlue 发来的一封电子邮件写道：我们的团队努力为后续航班的乘客提供便利。
An email from JetBlue read, Our team is working to accommodate customers on later flights.
新闻报道 2 一条致命的蛇逃离动物园后终于被追踪已经第二次溜走了。
News Report 2 A deadly snake which had finally been tracked down after escaping a zoo has slipped away for the second time.
毒蛇迫使关闭上周，工作人员注意到了这个景点的失踪事件。
The poisonous snake forced the closure of the attraction last week when staff noticed the disappearance.
经过六天的拼命搜寻，他最终找到并安置在一个本应安全的区域。
After six days of desperate searching he was eventually found and placed in a supposedly secure area.
但这只动物似乎并不喜欢动物园，因为他又一次逍遥法外。
But it seems the animal is no fan of the zoo because yet again he is out on the loose.
蛇是动物园却已经让工作人员感到沮丧。
The snake is a relative newcomer to the zoo but has already been frustrating its staff.
工作人员认为他挤出了新型节能灯泡周围的缝隙安装在蛇屋里面。
The staff believe he squeezed himself out of a gap located around new energy-saving bulbs installed inside the snake house.
他第一次被发现因为工作人员带来了特殊的机器在墙壁开口内追踪他。
He was only found the first time around because staff brought in a special machine to trace him inside a wall opening.
这种蛇是野生环境中最致命、毒性最强的它们的范围从 3 到 5 米长度。
This kind of snake is one of the most deadly and poisonous in the wild and they can range from 3 to 5 meters in length.
